meta.description: The application that shows and logs the lines an Xbase++ program sends with the ot4xb.dll logging functions (ot4xb_lSendLogStrFL, ot4xb_lSendLogStr): a tiny Win32 tray exe that receives them via WM_COPYDATA, appends them to a .log file and displays them in a RichEdit window. Use when working with ot4xb-log or ot4xb_log.exe.
